name: Etched Tablet
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the hunter trainer Jen'shan. She would have words with you when you're ready.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Now we teach them those things, and they teach us others. We become one race... almost. We be allies for long time now. So you remember to help them. And Jen'shan remember to help you.

Jen'shan teach you da ways of the hunter--teach you good. You never forget, Champion's be respected greatly by da tribe. You be havin' a large role to play in da future... you never forget that.

When you feel da need, come to Jen'shan. She teach you as much as she can when she feel you ready.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Jen'shan see a mighty Champion before her and da spirits approve.

Da path of da Champion is one of our oldest walks of life. Da Horde turned to us when they be just strugglin' to survive on Azeroth, and they ask us to teach them, to show them the secrets of many tings. They were strong already: strong in shaman ways; strong in warrior ways. But the hunter path not be their path... then.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 2, 290 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: Etched Tablet
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.
